newsitem.title: USA: Commercial Net Lease shr offer at 4.85 mln.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Net Lease shr offer at 4.85 mln.

text.p: Commercial Net Lease Realty Inc said on Wednesday that it increased its public offering to 4.85 million common shares from three million at a price of $14 a share.
The real estate investment trust said it was making the offer with an underwriting group led by Smith Barney Inc.
It said it had granted the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 727,500 common shares to cover over allotments, if any.
It said it intended to use the net proceeds of the offering to repay its line of credit and fund property acquisitions.
Goldman, Sachs & Co, J.C. Bradford & Co, Legg Mason Wood Walker Inc, Raymond James and Associates and The Robinson-Humphrey Co Inc are also in the underwriting group, it said.
